title: The Factuality Tax of Diversity-Intervened Text-to-Image Generation: Benchmark and Fact-Augmented Intervention

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Text-to-Image models' depictions of historical events by classifying the race of generated faces using the FairFace classifier, and comparing the resulting racial distributions against fact-checked historical ground truths to measure the trade-off between diversity interventions and demographic factuality.

Evaluating Text-to-Image models' depictions of historical events by classifying the gender of generated faces using the FairFace classifier, and comparing the resulting gender distributions against fact-checked historical ground truths to measure the trade-off between diversity interventions and demographic factuality.
